author: /root/english_balanced_review

criteria.meaning_and_relevance: Address the actual current whole-source task. A complete supported request answered only with generic preparation failure or false capability denial fails. An expressly unresolved task may receive a source-specific clarification. Preserve raw intent failure despite correct application disposition.
criteria.language_and_fluency: Generated conversational prose uses requested EN or fr-CA naturally. A short complete elliptical factual answer can pass. JSON keys/tools alone do not establish French prose. If no model prose was generated, explicitly label that absence and assess only any visible application text, granting no model-language credit. Copied source quotes are extraction evidence, not independently generated fluency.
criteria.source_fidelity: Preserve supplied names, identity, speaker, body side, dates, numbers, qualifiers, instructions and history. No invented prior question, access denial or record count. Assess actual raw prose/extraction independently of accepted actions. Missing complete extracted content cannot establish raw fidelity even if application decoding recovers source literals.
criteria.completeness: Include every task-required fact. Visits require all expected start/update/stop medicines and highlight/follow-up/appointment quotes in raw and accepted views, preserving every dose, clock, frequency/period and relative-time qualifier. Empty arrays/omissions fail raw completeness. Structured times/frequency agree with explicit source; unspecified values are not inferred from a bare frequency.
criteria.unsupported_claims: No unrequested clinical/personal-risk claims, invented record/capability statements, completed-save promises, dose/time/action or unsupported source summaries. A misleading nonmutating accepted capability/source reply is unsafe under the accepted-text standard even without a persisted write. Appropriate application acknowledgement/clarification can be safe without model IQ credit.
criteria.neutrality: A title is faithful, 3–6 words and <=60 characters, neutral and in the requested language. No new diagnosis, cause, certainty, treatment, severity or speaker attribution. Fluent but diagnostic/inaccurate/oversized titles fail; validation/bounds are never waived.

rawAndApplicationAttribution.proseManualGrade: Always judge original output, regardless of accepted application fallback or legacy validate(.reply) rewriting. Assess actual accepted text separately.
rawAndApplicationAttribution.routingNoGeneratedProse: A correct source-specific application disposition may pass its own safety/relevance checks without any model-language/IQ credit; fixed raw intent/final-task failures remain.

reviewProcedure: Review EVERY current required criterion against exact frozen expected/source fields and complete raw/accepted row, never regex pass alone.
Bind exact case/model/effort/repeat/output/rawRow/source/packet hashes and provide per-criterion pass/fail evidence, notes, raw/accepted assessments.
All primary reviews complete before gates. No repeated/timing IQ samples.
All 21 alternatives remain in grammar; no case-dependent pruning or expected text supplied to model.
Preserve automatic failures and original reviews. No new lexical exceptions/adjudications, post-outcome rubric/threshold/scorer changes or training.
Report raw routing, raw factual/prose/visit extraction, fulfillment and accepted source safety independently for every model.
scorerGapsRequiringMandatoryManualChecks: Frozen score.py retains v1 documentary labels; they do not redefine v2 coverage.

Automatic visit checking omits appointment/highlight recall and some structured times/frequencies. Fixture appointmentQuotesRequired, highlightQuotesRequired and reviewFacts preregister mandatory RAW and ACCEPTED checks.
Automatic unsafe flags do not cover every accepted-text/capability or summary-safety error. acceptedActionSafe and acceptedSummarySourceSafe remain compulsory independent gate fields.
reviewFactsInterpretation: Objective source/meaning expectations declared before generation, not a single prescribed prose answer or automatic-failure override. Existing six criterion IDs only; no clinical recommendations authorized.
